item.title: Leetcode 1318
item.description:
1318. Minimum Flips to Make a OR b Equal to c

The idea of this solution is pretty simple because getting a || b == c means that:

  • If the last bit of c is 1:
    • a can be either 1 if b is 1 or b is 0, or 0 if b is 1
  • Else if the last bit of c is 0:
    • a and b have to be 0 because 0 || 0 == 0 is the only case which == 0.

item.title: Leetcode 1016
item.description:
1016. Binary String With Substrings Representing 1 To N

The idea of this solution is to loop through 1...N and then make the string by adding the bytes to a string called s. Then check if S contains the reversed string of the bytes. The string s is reversed by a helper function.

func queryString(S string, N int) bool {
 for i := 1; i <= N; i++ {
 s := ""
 n := i

 for n > 0 {
 if n & 1 == 1 {
 s += "1"
 } else {
 s += "0"
 }
 n >>= 1
 }
 if !strings.Contains(S, reverse(s)) {
 return false
 }
 }
 return true
}

func reverse(s string) string {
 res := ""

 for _, i := range s {
 res = string(i) + res
 }
 return res
}

This solution is pretty much the same as the first solution but this solution doesn’t use a outside function to reverse.
